kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
احتضرن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرْنَ (iḥtaḍarna) /iħ.ta.dˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرْنَ (uḥtuḍirna) /uħ.tu.dˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# اِحْتَضِرْنَ (iḥtaḍirna) /iħ.ta.dˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
